response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial experience (founding GISCollective, building GIS applications for Green Map) and low-latency distributed systems work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of requests per second. However, the core requirement of modern C++ or Rust is weakly met — his C/C++ work dates to a brief 2014–2015 stint, with most recent experience in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. There is no direct routing or navigation guidance experience, making the fit uncertain despite adjacent strengths.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial data platform experience as founder of GISCollective and Green Map contributor
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience (async I/O, caching, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Demonstrated adaptability across stacks and strong quality practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling)
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience and no Rust; primary languages are TypeScript/Node.js and DLang
No experience with routing engines, routing tiles, or navigation guidance systems
Recent roles (pricing, direct mail, AI tooling) are far from map data pipeline engineering
